title: Dentist in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Public insurance covers the basics** at any Berlin dentist: **two check-ups a year**, tartar removal once a year and standard fillings, with nothing to pay at the counter.
**Crowns, bridges and dentures run on a fixed subsidy.** The Krankenkasse pays **60%** of the standard treatment price, and everything above that fixed amount is yours.
**The Bonusheft raises it** to **70%** with a check-up in each of the last **5 calendar years**, and to **75%** with **10 years** unbroken. A missing **2020** stamp never counts against you.
**The count uses calendar years before the treatment starts.** For a crown next year, an empty **2026** drops you to 60%, however many years you went before.
**Real 2026 amounts:** a back-tooth crown gets **€239.03 / €278.87 / €298.79**; a bridge or implant for one missing tooth gets **€552.96 / €645.12 / €691.20**.
**My move:** find the booklet now, and if this year has no stamp, book a check-up before **31 December**.
